s: February 7, 2025 - Dreamachine by Habibi, released 31 May 2024 1. On The Road 2. In My Dreams 3. POV 4. Do You Want Me Now 5. Interlude 6. My Moon 7. Losing Control 8. Fairweather Friend 9. Alone Tonight Co-founded by Detroit natives Rahill Jamalifard and Lenny Lynch, Habibi got its start in Brooklyn in 2011, earning early raves everywhere from Pitchfork and NME to All Things Considered and The New Yorker, who praised the band for infusing “the Colgate-white glisten of sixties-girl-group pop with an uncensored edge.” Dreamachine, Habibi’s mesmerizing new record releasing on Kill Rock Stars, marks a major sonic evolution for the band, rising beyond the critically acclaimed five-piece’s garage rock roots to arrive at a singular swirl of analog and digital elements that underpin their search for spiritual and physical transcendence.
